Title: STRENGTH
Body: Adds 3 damage to the next {stacks} attacks.

Title: DOUBLE ATTACK
Body: The next {stacks} attack this character makes deals double damage.

Title: POISON
Body: Deals damage equal to it's stacks ({stacks}) and the end of the turn and then loses a stack.

Title: FROZEN
Body: Cannot act for {stacks} more turns.

Title: SHIELD
Body: Absorbs the next {stacks} damage. Only lasts for this turn.

Title: BLOCK
Body: Reduces the damage this character takes by 3 for the next {stacks} hits.

Title: PARRY
Body: Negates the damage for {stacks} hits and reflects the damage back to the attacker.

Title: ROOTED
Body: This character is unable to use move actions for {stacks} turns.

Title: DOUBLE SHIELD
Body: The next {stacks} Shield this character gains is doubled.

Title: DODGE
Body: Negates the damage for {stacks} hits and moves the character away from the source of damage.

Title: WEAKEN
Body: Subtracts {amount} damage from each attack made.

Title: TAUNT
Body: This character must move toward or attack the source of the Taunt for {stacks} turns.

Title: POISON BLADE
Body: For {stacks} more turns, every attack this character lands also applies {amount} Poison.

Title: STEALTH
Body: Enemies cannot target this character for {stacks} more turns.

Title: VULNERABLE
Body: Adds {amount} damage to each attack taken.

Title: EMPOWERED
Body: Multiplies {status} granted to all {targets} in range by {amount}.

Title: POTENT
Body: Test {amount} to the potency of {status} for all {targets} in range.

Title: STANDING WARD
Body: Grants {amount} {status} to all {targets} in range {timing}.

Title: INNATE
Body: Always in hand. Never enters the draw or discard pile.

Title: COOLDOWN
Body: Unusable for {magnitude} turns after it is played.

Title: DORMANT
Body: Unusable for {magnitude} turns after you gain it.
